description: The wallet steps for a Cubicle vault as UNSIGNED transactions and EIP-712 typed data for the owner's own wallet. Open: call without vault for the transaction that opens it. Fund and hire: call again with the new vault's address (from my_vaults) for allow + deposit and the mandate to sign. Withdraw: withdraw_shares queues shares, then claim_shares pays what the vault's free funds cover to the owner. Chain 4663 is Robinhood Chain (real USDG; open to any wallet since 2026-10-07, no deposit cap; the contracts are not externally audited, so deposit only what you can afford to lose); 36927 is the devnet (test money). Signs and sends nothing.

administrator.description: who administers the vault under the mandate (second call), e.g. llm-nemotron-dual

chain.description: 4663 Robinhood Chain (real money) or 36927 the devnet (test money); defaults to the devnet

claim_shares.description: withdrawal step two: whole shares to claim (read claimableRedeemRequest(0, owner) on the vault)

deposit_usd.description: USD of the stable to deposit (second call)

kind.description: what the account is for: spot (trades on Uniswap today) or futures (margin; settles when the venue sends statements)

margin_usd.description: margin vaults only: the most the mandate may ever lose (second call)

market.description: spot administrators only: the market it buys

owner.description: the 0x address of the wallet that owns (or will own) the vault

vault.description: the vault's 0x address (every call after the first)

withdraw_shares.description: withdrawal step one: whole shares to queue (read balanceOf(owner) on the vault)

name: vault_prepare
